title: Sequential logic & FSMs
circuit: Moore 101 sequence detector (overlapping), one input X, one output Z, two D flip-flops

candidates.name: Pad-native FSM
candidates.oneLine: Own engine: state diagram with travelling token, linked tables, equations, growing timing strip.
candidates.accuracy: check-pad-native-fsm.mjs: engine vs hand-written key (state table, encoded/D table, minimised equations, test sequence) 49/49 PASS
candidates.caveats: Diagram positions are hand-placed for this machine; other machines need a build-time layout step. D flip-flops only in the UI.

candidates.name: DigitalJS 0.14 FSM cell
candidates.oneLine: DigitalJS circuit with its FSM cell, running clock, own state graph and waveform monitor.
candidates.accuracy: check-digitaljs-fsm.mjs: FSM cell run headless in Node (Clock swapped for a Button), test sequence + 8 table entries 20/20 PASS
candidates.caveats: Mealy only, numbered states, Z written on every arrow; dagre graph draws self-loops as labels on the node; 2.3 MB bundle uncompressed.

candidates.name: Logic (jppellet)
candidates.oneLine: Gate-level build: two D flip-flops, next-state gates, CLK push button, in Logic's editor.
candidates.accuracy: check-logic-jppellet.mjs: drives this page in headless Chrome, test sequence state and Z per period and per edge 4/4 PASS
candidates.caveats: No state diagram or table; hand-placed gates with crossing wires; at phone width zoomed to ~39%, so inputs are ~10 px targets.

candidates.name: state-machine-cat + highlight
candidates.oneLine: Static smcat/graphviz diagram rendered at build time; clock toggles a current-state highlight.
candidates.accuracy: check-smcat-highlight.mjs: smcat source parsed by smcat vs key, plus the tiny engine on the test sequence, 21/21 PASS
candidates.caveats: No motion, tables or timing; rounded state boxes (smcat paths); tall top-down diagram on phones puts S3 below the fold.
